comparison.objective: Insert both ends of a short patch cord into two tester jacks without unseating the first; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR coordinates deformable-cord slack and two connector insertions. Candidate performs rigid fine-tool alignment, screw torque, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and guarded impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both plugs inserted ≥15 mm, tester units unmoved, and grippers released. Candidate requires two safe axial stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Connector insertion with cord management is a different tested ability from mechanical adjustment and dynamic stopping validation.
